newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-NORMAN FIVE BEHIND IN OWN TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NORMAN FIVE BEHIND IN OWN TOURNAMENT.

text.p: World number one Greg Norman suffered badly in wild weather on Friday to finish five shots off the lead at the midway stage of his own tournament.
Norman, playing in his last event before taking a three-month break to recuperate from a back problem, shot a three-over-par 75 for a 144 total at Royal Melbourne.
Dutchman Rolf Muntz (72), American Jerry Kelly (69), New Zealand's Elliot Boult (70) and Lucas Parsons of Australia (72) shared the lead in the Greg Norman Classic on five-under 139.
Norman, two shots off the pace after an opening 69, had dropped another two shots by the time he reached the ninth tee, only for a fierce storm to drive players from the course.
The Australian then bogeyed the par-four ninth when players returned to the course an hour later and went on to triple bogey the final hole.
